CREATE TABLE __matview_store_v_single (
    g TEXT NOT NULL,
    s INTEGER,
    a REAL,
    tt REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
    __mv_row_count BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    __mv_cnt_s_1 BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (g)
)

CREATE TABLE __matview_store_v_join (
    g TEXT NOT NULL,
    s REAL,
    __mv_row_count BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    __mv_cnt_s_1 BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (g)
)
CREATE VIEW v_single AS SELECT g, s, a, tt FROM __matview_store_v_single
CREATE VIEW v_join AS SELECT g, s FROM __matview_store_v_join
